description: Read current public Hyperliquid positions for a frozen, research-screened whale cohort. Returns account-normalized consensus, participation, agreement, effective-wallet count, single-wallet concentration, liquidity and optional recent fills for the focus symbol. Use this for whale/smart-money positioning as one evidence family, never as a standalone signal.

includeRecentFlow.description: Also inspect recent focus-symbol fills for at most four leading contributors.

symbol.description: Focus symbol; defaults to the charted symbol.

topSymbols.description: Market-consensus rows to return. Default 10, max 15.

name: hyperliquid_whale_read
